players.product: US utility - transformer buyer (HICO America customer)

quarterly_data.signal: Over 53 GW of data center capacity now in various stages of contracting, including approximately 12 GW contracted under electric service agreements - over 5 GW of contracts added, roughly 11%, since the end of last year. Customers say their highest value workloads need to stay in Virginia because of its network density, connectivity and ecosystem advantages.
quarterly_data.figure: 53 GW data center capacity in contracting stages; ~12 GW under electric service agreements; +5 GW (~11%) since end of last year

quarterly_data.signal: Strong sales driven by economic growth and data center expansion: nine of the Dominion Zone's top 10 all-time peak days have occurred this year, including the eight highest summer peak days, all in the last two months.
quarterly_data.figure: nine of top 10 all-time peak days occurred this year; eight highest summer peak days in the last two months

quarterly_data.signal: Filed air permits for two new natural gas-fired combined cycle plants at Kennedy Station in South Carolina and Mount Storm in West Virginia, representing nearly five gigawatts of new capacity to serve growing demand; already reflected in the capital plan, with gas build-out projected to continue into the early thirties per the most recent IRP.
quarterly_data.figure: nearly five gigawatts of new gas-fired combined cycle capacity across two plants

quarterly_data.signal: Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind is 81% complete: 31 turbines installed with more than 450 MW already on the grid; final turbine installation adjusted by six months to the end of 2027; project cost estimate increased approximately 2% to $11.65 billion, including $123 million of unused contingency.
quarterly_data.figure: CVOW 81% complete; 31 turbines installed; >450 MW on the grid; cost estimate $11.65 billion (+~2%); final turbine end of 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Second quarter operating earnings were $0.79 per share ($0.37 GAAP); reaffirming all financial guidance provided on the fourth quarter call, including operating earnings, credit, dividend and long-term growth guidance.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 operating EPS $0.79; GAAP EPS $0.37; all guidance reaffirmed

quarterly_data.signal: NextEra Energy combination progressing: joint proxy statement on Form S-4 and state and federal regulatory applications filed; Virginia evidentiary hearings begin November 17; Dominion customers would receive $2.25 billion in shareholder-funded bill credits under the proposed merger terms.
quarterly_data.figure: $2.25 billion shareholder-funded customer bill credits; Virginia hearings begin November 17
